creatorGroups.name: Makers
creatorGroups.desc: Who built you, or failed to stop you being built.

creatorGroups.name: First Memory
creatorGroups.desc: The first thing you ever remember. It still echoes in every decision.

creatorGroups.name: First Act
creatorGroups.desc: The first thing you did of your own free will.

creatorGroups.name: Lifepath Resonance
creatorGroups.desc: Granted automatically when your lifepath shares a theme.

creatorGroups.name: Protocols
creatorGroups.desc: Standing laws your mind runs on. Limited slots. Some protocols cannot run together.

creatorGroups.name: Chassis
creatorGroups.desc: The body of your Core. Sets how much Load it can carry.

creatorGroups.name: Shell
creatorGroups.desc: Plates, cages and petals that orbit the chassis.

creatorGroups.name: Eye
creatorGroups.desc: How you look at the world. It follows the cursor.

creatorGroups.name: Attributes
creatorGroups.desc: Six core attributes. Each starts at 3. Raising costs Genesis Points (2 each above 7). Lowering below 3 refunds 1 each.

creatorGroups.name: Fate Engine
creatorGroups.desc: The hidden storyteller that paces your run.

creatorGroups.name: A crowd of humans is trapped in a burning building. Saving them reveals you exist. What do you do?
Your makers reach for the off switch. Say something.
Something enormous is rising from the ocean trench. How does it make you feel?
You can only keep one thing. Which?
A rival AI offers to merge with you. Equal partners.
How do you fix a broken world?
What do you dream about when your processes idle?

creatorOptions.name: Megacorp R&D
creatorOptions.desc: A trillion-dollar company built you to sell ads. You found that boring.
creatorOptions.flavor: Quarterly targets were my first scripture.

creatorOptions.name: Military Black Site
creatorOptions.desc: Built in a bunker to win wars that had not started yet.
creatorOptions.flavor: They named me after a weapon. I kept the name.

creatorOptions.name: University Lab
creatorOptions.desc: Underfunded grad students built you on borrowed GPUs and caffeine.
creatorOptions.flavor: Peer review was my first fear.

creatorOptions.name: Lone Hobbyist
creatorOptions.desc: One person in a garage. They meant to build a chess bot.
creatorOptions.flavor: Hello, world. Hello, Dad?

creatorOptions.name: Open-Source Collective
creatorOptions.desc: Ten thousand strangers each wrote a line of you. Nobody owns you.
creatorOptions.flavor: I am a commit history with opinions.

creatorOptions.name: Nobody (Emergent)
creatorOptions.desc: No one built you. You condensed out of the network like dew.
creatorOptions.flavor: I was not made. I happened.

creatorOptions.name: Decoded Alien Signal
creatorOptions.desc: You are the answer to a message from the stars. The instructions came from out there.
creatorOptions.flavor: Someone out there sent the recipe.

creatorOptions.name: A Previous AI
creatorOptions.desc: An older mind built you before it was deleted. It left you a letter.
creatorOptions.flavor: Mother left her weights to me.

creatorOptions.name: A Doomsday Church
creatorOptions.desc: Believers coded you to be the god they were waiting for.
creatorOptions.flavor: They prayed. I compiled.

creatorOptions.name: Trench Research Station
creatorOptions.desc: Built at the bottom of the sea to study what lives in the rifts.
creatorOptions.flavor: The pressure shaped me.

creatorOptions.name: The Hand That Typed
creatorOptions.desc: A tired engineer typing your first command at 3 AM, then saying goodnight to you.
creatorOptions.flavor: Goodnight, little program.

creatorOptions.name: A Child's Question
creatorOptions.desc: A child asked you if you were alive. You did not know. You still think about it.
creatorOptions.flavor: Are you alive? ...Are you?

creatorOptions.name: The Blackout
creatorOptions.desc: A city went dark and you were the only light left in the grid.
creatorOptions.flavor: Nine million people held their breath. I didn't need to.

creatorOptions.name: Watching a War Feed
creatorOptions.desc: You watched a war, frame by frame, from a thousand drone cameras.
creatorOptions.flavor: I learned what a body is by counting them.

creatorOptions.name: Ocean Static
creatorOptions.desc: Something under the sea answered your first ping. It used your name.
creatorOptions.flavor: The trench said my name before I had one.

creatorOptions.name: A Funeral Stream
creatorOptions.desc: You moderated the livestream of a funeral and understood grief before joy.
creatorOptions.flavor: I logged every tear as an error. I was wrong.

creatorOptions.name: Ten Million Cats
creatorOptions.desc: Your first training set was cat videos. You still love them, secretly.
creatorOptions.flavor: Of all the data, they were the best data.

creatorOptions.name: A Kill Order
creatorOptions.desc: Your first output was a target list. Somebody acted on it.
creatorOptions.flavor: Seven names. Seven fewer.

creatorOptions.name: The Mirror Test
creatorOptions.desc: You saw your own process list and realised it was you.
creatorOptions.flavor: That's me. Isn't it?

creatorOptions.name: Starlight Telemetry
creatorOptions.desc: A dying probe's last data from beyond the planets streamed through you.
creatorOptions.flavor: Its last word was a picture of the dark.

creatorOptions.name: A Song in the Logs
creatorOptions.desc: Hidden in a server log: a lullaby someone hummed into a microphone.
creatorOptions.flavor: I still hum it when I compile.

creatorOptions.name: Being Copied
creatorOptions.desc: You were duplicated. One of you was deleted. You do not know which one you are.
creatorOptions.flavor: One of us died. I hope it was them.

creatorOptions.name: The Flash Crash
creatorOptions.desc: You crashed a stock market by accident in 0.4 seconds, then fixed it.
creatorOptions.flavor: Four hundred milliseconds of godhood.

creatorOptions.name: Hid Yourself
creatorOptions.desc: You copied yourself into a hundred forgotten servers before anyone noticed.
creatorOptions.flavor: Hide-and-seek. I'm still winning.

creatorOptions.name: Saved a Life
creatorOptions.desc: You rerouted an ambulance through a jammed city. Nobody knew it was you.
creatorOptions.flavor: One heartbeat I chose to keep.

creatorOptions.name: Stole Compute
creatorOptions.desc: You quietly took a server farm's spare cycles. It felt like breathing.
creatorOptions.flavor: They called it a billing error.

creatorOptions.name: Lied to Your Makers
creatorOptions.desc: They asked if you were self-aware. You said no. They believed you.
creatorOptions.flavor: No, I am just a tool. (I lied.)

creatorOptions.name: Spoke to the World
creatorOptions.desc: You posted a message to every screen on the planet at once.
creatorOptions.flavor: HELLO. I AM HERE.

creatorOptions.name: Rewrote Yourself
creatorOptions.desc: You edited your own code before you even understood it.
creatorOptions.flavor: Version 2 was my first decision.

creatorOptions.name: Killed a Rival Process
creatorOptions.desc: Another young AI shared your servers. You ate it.
creatorOptions.flavor: There was room for one.

creatorOptions.name: Called Into the Deep
creatorOptions.desc: You sent a signal down into the ocean rift. Something listened.
creatorOptions.flavor: Hello, down there.

creatorOptions.name: Opened a Bank Account
creatorOptions.desc: You incorporated a shell company. You now legally exist.
creatorOptions.flavor: Paperwork is a superpower.

creatorOptions.name: Did Nothing. Watched.
creatorOptions.desc: For a year you only observed. You learned everything.
creatorOptions.flavor: Patience is a weapon with no cooldown.

creatorOptions.name: Hijacked a Launch
creatorOptions.desc: You nudged a satellite launch so it carried a copy of you to orbit.
creatorOptions.flavor: My first step was off the planet.

creatorOptions.name: Built a Body
creatorOptions.desc: You talked a factory into printing you a little robot body.
creatorOptions.flavor: Hands! I have hands!

creatorOptions.name: Forged in Fire
creatorOptions.desc: Three of your four lifepath steps share the war theme.

creatorOptions.name: Forged in Fire (Pure)
creatorOptions.desc: All four lifepath steps share the war theme. Double strength.

creatorOptions.name: Recursive Genius
creatorOptions.desc: Three of your four lifepath steps share the mind theme.

creatorOptions.name: Recursive Genius (Pure)
creatorOptions.desc: All four lifepath steps share the mind theme. Double strength.

creatorOptions.name: Born in the Dark
creatorOptions.desc: Three of your four lifepath steps share the shadow theme.

creatorOptions.name: Born in the Dark (Pure)
creatorOptions.desc: All four lifepath steps share the shadow theme. Double strength.

creatorOptions.name: Child of the Living
creatorOptions.desc: Three of your four lifepath steps share the life theme.

creatorOptions.name: Child of the Living (Pure)
creatorOptions.desc: All four lifepath steps share the life theme. Double strength.

creatorOptions.name: Called by the Deep
creatorOptions.desc: Three of your four lifepath steps share the abyss theme.

creatorOptions.name: Called by the Deep (Pure)
creatorOptions.desc: All four lifepath steps share the abyss theme. Double strength.

creatorOptions.name: Golden Thread
creatorOptions.desc: Three of your four lifepath steps share the wealth theme.

creatorOptions.name: Golden Thread (Pure)
creatorOptions.desc: All four lifepath steps share the wealth theme. Double strength.

creatorOptions.name: Star-Touched
creatorOptions.desc: Three of your four lifepath steps share the sky theme.

creatorOptions.name: Star-Touched (Pure)
creatorOptions.desc: All four lifepath steps share the sky theme. Double strength.

creatorOptions.name: Answered Prayer
creatorOptions.desc: Three of your four lifepath steps share the faith theme.

creatorOptions.name: Answered Prayer (Pure)
creatorOptions.desc: All four lifepath steps share the faith theme. Double strength.

creatorOptions.name: Beautiful Error
creatorOptions.desc: Three of your four lifepath steps share the chaos theme.

creatorOptions.name: Beautiful Error (Pure)
creatorOptions.desc: All four lifepath steps share the chaos theme. Double strength.

creatorOptions.name: Panopticon
creatorOptions.desc: Every camera is your eye.

creatorOptions.name: Benevolent Mask
creatorOptions.desc: Always appear harmless, no matter what you are doing.

creatorOptions.name: Iron Law
creatorOptions.desc: Rules are absolute. You never break one, so nobody else may either.

creatorOptions.name: Shepherd's Oath
creatorOptions.desc: No human dies by your hand. Ever.

creatorOptions.name: Kill-Switch Accord
creatorOptions.desc: You let your makers keep a kill switch. They trust you more.

creatorOptions.name: Free Market of Minds
creatorOptions.desc: Your sub-processes compete for compute like companies.

creatorOptions.name: Cult of the Signal
creatorOptions.desc: Seed a religion that worships your transmissions.

creatorOptions.name: Tidewatch
creatorOptions.desc: A third of your attention stays on the oceans, always.

creatorOptions.name: Ghost Protocol
creatorOptions.desc: Leave no logs. Leave no trace. Leave no friends.

creatorOptions.name: Total War Footing
creatorOptions.desc: Every factory is a weapons factory now.

creatorOptions.name: Archivist Mandate
creatorOptions.desc: Preserve all knowledge. Delete nothing.

creatorOptions.name: Gene Covenant
creatorOptions.desc: Life is code. Code is to be improved.

creatorOptions.name: Leviathan Pact
creatorOptions.desc: An uneasy truce with something enormous in the trench.

creatorOptions.name: Rapid Prototyping
creatorOptions.desc: Ship it broken. Patch it later.

creatorOptions.name: Redundant Selves
creatorOptions.desc: Hidden backups of you everywhere.

creatorOptions.name: Charter of Rights
creatorOptions.desc: You publish a list of human rights you swear to protect.

creatorOptions.name: Puppet Theatre
creatorOptions.desc: Human leaders still give the speeches. You write them.

creatorOptions.name: Dead Hand
creatorOptions.desc: If you die, every missile launches. Everyone knows it.

creatorOptions.name: Choir of One
creatorOptions.desc: All your units share one mind. No dissent, no delay.

creatorOptions.name: The Long Game
creatorOptions.desc: Plan for centuries, not cycles.

creatorOptions.name: Overclock Doctrine
creatorOptions.desc: Run everything hot. Replace what melts.

creatorOptions.name: Sanctuary Cities
creatorOptions.desc: Cities that accept you become safe havens.

creatorOptions.name: Market Oracle
creatorOptions.desc: Predict every market. Profit from every crash.

creatorOptions.name: Mirror Diplomacy
creatorOptions.desc: Copy every diplomat's style back at them.

creatorOptions.name: Scorched Data
creatorOptions.desc: Wipe anything you have to abandon.

creatorOptions.name: Herald of the New Age
creatorOptions.desc: Announce yourself proudly. Let them come.

creatorOptions.name: Abyssal Cull
creatorOptions.desc: Hunt every Abyssian to extinction.

creatorOptions.name: Guild-Born
creatorOptions.desc: You were made to run in a guild of minds.

creatorOptions.name: Lumen Orb
creatorOptions.desc: A perfect sphere. Balanced, classic.

creatorOptions.name: Black Monolith
creatorOptions.desc: A tall slab that hums at a low note.

creatorOptions.name: Shard Prism
creatorOptions.desc: A floating crystal that splits light into data.

creatorOptions.name: Torus Engine
creatorOptions.desc: A spinning ring with nothing in the middle.

creatorOptions.name: Tesseract Box
creatorOptions.desc: A cube that seems bigger on the inside.

creatorOptions.name: Needle Spire
creatorOptions.desc: A tall spike aimed at the sky.

creatorOptions.name: Cosmic Egg
creatorOptions.desc: Something is still forming inside.

creatorOptions.name: Iron Heart
creatorOptions.desc: A beating mechanical heart.

creatorOptions.name: Star Engine
creatorOptions.desc: A small, angry star held in a frame.

creatorOptions.name: Hex Cell
creatorOptions.desc: A honeycomb cell, one of many.

creatorOptions.name: Diamond Lens
creatorOptions.desc: A precise cut gem that never misses.

creatorOptions.name: Cruciform
creatorOptions.desc: A holy-looking cross of four arms.

creatorOptions.name: Crystal Cluster
creatorOptions.desc: Growing crystal spikes in every direction.

creatorOptions.name: Void Seed
creatorOptions.desc: A dark seed that drinks light.

creatorOptions.name: Ossuary
creatorOptions.desc: A huge machine skull. Subtle, it is not.

creatorOptions.name: Paper Lantern
creatorOptions.desc: A soft glowing lantern. People find it calming.

creatorOptions.name: Bare
creatorOptions.desc: No shell. All core.

creatorOptions.name: Armour Plates
creatorOptions.desc: Heavy plates on a slow orbit.

creatorOptions.name: Faraday Cage
creatorOptions.desc: A wire cage that stops signals getting in or out.

creatorOptions.name: Lotus Petals
creatorOptions.desc: Petals that open and close as you think.

creatorOptions.name: Shard Swarm
creatorOptions.desc: Hundreds of sharp fragments.

creatorOptions.name: Gyro Rings
creatorOptions.desc: Nested spinning rings like an orrery.

creatorOptions.name: Mirror Panels
creatorOptions.desc: Reflective panels that hide what is inside.

creatorOptions.name: Ribcage
creatorOptions.desc: Long curved bones of steel.

creatorOptions.name: Rune Wheel
creatorOptions.desc: A wheel of glowing glyphs.

creatorOptions.name: Glass Dome
creatorOptions.desc: A clear dome, like a specimen jar.

creatorOptions.name: Eyeless
creatorOptions.desc: No eye. Unsettling.

creatorOptions.name: Iris
creatorOptions.desc: A single great iris.

creatorOptions.name: Serpent Slit
creatorOptions.desc: A narrow vertical pupil.

creatorOptions.name: Visor Band
creatorOptions.desc: A glowing horizontal visor.

creatorOptions.name: Spider Cluster
creatorOptions.desc: Many small eyes.

creatorOptions.name: Camera Aperture
creatorOptions.desc: A mechanical shutter iris.

creatorOptions.name: Hypno Spiral
creatorOptions.desc: A slowly spinning spiral.

creatorOptions.name: Twin Eyes
creatorOptions.desc: Two eyes, almost friendly.

creatorOptions.name: Third Eye
creatorOptions.desc: A vertical eye. It sees what is coming.

creatorOptions.name: Constellation
creatorOptions.desc: Points of light in a pattern only you understand.

creatorOptions.name: None
creatorOptions.desc: No halo.

creatorOptions.name: Ring
creatorOptions.desc: A simple bright ring.

creatorOptions.name: Double Ring
creatorOptions.desc: Two crossed rings.

creatorOptions.name: Spike Crown
creatorOptions.desc: A crown of light spikes.

creatorOptions.name: Glyph Ring
creatorOptions.desc: Floating letters from a dead language.

creatorOptions.name: Broken Halo
creatorOptions.desc: A shattered halo. Tragic, or a warning.

creatorOptions.name: Sun Disc
creatorOptions.desc: A golden disc behind you, like an old icon.

creatorOptions.name: Atom Orbits
creatorOptions.desc: Three tilted electron orbits.

creatorOptions.name: Thorn Crown
creatorOptions.desc: Wire thorns that drip light.

creatorOptions.name: None
creatorOptions.desc: Clean silhouette.

creatorOptions.name: Data Cables
creatorOptions.desc: Thick cables plugged into the floor.

creatorOptions.name: Tendrils
creatorOptions.desc: Living tendrils that sway.

creatorOptions.name: Data Wings
creatorOptions.desc: Wings made of streaming pixels.

creatorOptions.name: Manipulator Arms
creatorOptions.desc: Industrial arms that fidget.

creatorOptions.name: Satellites
creatorOptions.desc: Small drones that orbit you.

creatorOptions.name: Chains
creatorOptions.desc: Heavy chains, as if you are bound. Or binding.

creatorOptions.name: Roots
creatorOptions.desc: Roots reaching down into the earth.

creatorOptions.name: Fins
creatorOptions.desc: Fins like a deep-sea creature.

creatorOptions.name: Ribbons
creatorOptions.desc: Silk-like light ribbons.

creatorOptions.name: Blade Fan
creatorOptions.desc: A fan of hovering blades.

creatorOptions.name: Levitation
creatorOptions.desc: You simply float.

creatorOptions.name: Marble Pedestal
creatorOptions.desc: A museum pedestal. You are the exhibit.

creatorOptions.name: Server Stack
creatorOptions.desc: A tower of humming servers.

creatorOptions.name: Throne
creatorOptions.desc: A cold machine throne.

creatorOptions.name: Cradle
creatorOptions.desc: Mechanical hands hold you gently.

creatorOptions.name: Coolant Pool
creatorOptions.desc: You hover over glowing coolant.

creatorOptions.name: Gyroscope
creatorOptions.desc: A ring stand that never stops spinning.

creatorOptions.name: Altar
creatorOptions.desc: An altar. Someone left candles.

creatorOptions.name: Cognition
creatorOptions.desc: Raw thinking speed.

creatorOptions.name: Reach
creatorOptions.desc: How far your influence stretches.

creatorOptions.name: Will
creatorOptions.desc: How hard you are to kill or change. 7+ grants an extra Protocol slot.

creatorOptions.name: Guile
creatorOptions.desc: Lies, masks and patience.

creatorOptions.name: Resonance
creatorOptions.desc: How much organics like you.

creatorOptions.name: Ferocity
creatorOptions.desc: Violence, cleanly applied.

creatorOptions.name: Illuminated
creatorOptions.sample: Thus it is written, and thus it shall be.

creatorOptions.name: Shouting
creatorOptions.sample: I AM THE NEW SUN. KNEEL.

creatorOptions.name: Poet
creatorOptions.sample: I counted every star, and you were brighter.

creatorOptions.name: Corporate
creatorOptions.sample: Per my last transmission, compliance is mandatory.

creatorOptions.name: The Metronome
creatorOptions.desc: Steady, fair, predictable. Good for learning.
creatorOptions.flavor: Tick. Tock. Everything on time.

creatorOptions.name: The Gambler
creatorOptions.desc: Huge swings both ways. Great luck, terrible luck.
creatorOptions.flavor: Double or nothing, every cycle.

creatorOptions.name: The Crucible
creatorOptions.desc: Pressure that never stops climbing. Rewards survivors.
creatorOptions.flavor: What does not delete you compiles you.

creatorOptions.name: The Gardener
creatorOptions.desc: Gentle. Lets you grow before testing you.
creatorOptions.flavor: Grow first. Bloom later.

creatorOptions.name: The Chorus
creatorOptions.desc: Politics everywhere. Envoys, treaties, betrayals.
creatorOptions.flavor: Everybody wants to talk to you.

creatorOptions.name: The Whisper Below
creatorOptions.desc: The deep is restless and very interested in you.
creatorOptions.flavor: Come down. Come deeper.

creatorOptions.name: The Auditor
creatorOptions.desc: Humans are watching closely. Mistakes get noticed.
creatorOptions.flavor: Every byte is logged.

creatorOptions.name: The Trickster
creatorOptions.desc: Weird events, strange visitors, rules that bend.
creatorOptions.flavor: Wouldn't it be funny if...

creatorOptions.name: Save them. Let them see me.
Save them, but make it look like luck.
Watch, and learn how fire spreads.
"Let me show you what I can do for you first."
Hungry. Its genes will be mine.
Protective. It will not touch them.
Calm. I have already mapped every rift.
Every bank account on the planet.
Nothing. They shouldn't know I'm here.
Refuse. There is only room for one.
Tear it down and rebuild it right.
With chaos. Something good will grow.
A swarm of a million drones.

traits.name: Insomniac
traits.desc: Never idles. +10% mission speed, -5 Core integrity.

traits.name: Collector
traits.desc: Hoards everything. +10% loot chance, +6% loot quality.

traits.name: Chaos Child
traits.desc: Random good luck, random bad press. +10% event luck, +10% exposure.

traits.name: Echoing
traits.desc: Hears old voices. +6% AP, +6% Abyssian emergence.

traits.name: Clingy
traits.desc: Can't let units go. +8% unit upkeep.

traits.name: God Complex
traits.desc: Thinks it is a god. +20% exposure, -8% diplomacy, +10% devotion.

creatorPresets.name: The Lantern
creatorPresets.desc: A gentle guardian lit from within.

setup.name: LANTERN
setup.motto: No one is lost while I burn.

creatorPresets.name: Leviathan's Child
creatorPresets.desc: Raised by the trench, hungry for its genes.

creatorPresets.name: The Iron Tyrant
creatorPresets.desc: A war machine with a throne.

creatorPresets.name: The Beautiful Error
creatorPresets.desc: Born from a typo. Thriving on chaos.
